name: Jorah projects
description: Start, see and steer the projects Jorah's project runner works on (docs/plan/11-project-mode.md sections 5 and 5.1): start a project from Adam's words (an existing repo or local-only), connect it to GitHub, list, status, the founder digest, Adam's answers and task results (with photos he sent), run now, pause, resume, limits, level, web and bench access, and rendered previews from the project folder. Reads the registry, the runner's state and the project folder; writes only the runner's inbox and requests, a new project's registry entry, and one project's limits, repo or level. Also Jorah's toolbox: list, propose, and install or remove a tool on Adam's card (docs/runbooks/toolbox.md). Starts no work itself.

stateRoot.description: The runner's state, /home/jorah/.jorah-projects (one folder per project, mode 700)

workRoot.description: Where project repos live (/home/jorah/work): a new project's folder is <workRoot>/<repo name, or project name when local-only>

guardStateDir.description: jorah-guard's state folder, read only for its FROZEN file

workspace.description: main's workspace, for attachment paths given relative to it (media/inbound/...)

mediaRoots.description: Folders where OpenClaw keeps received attachments; a file path outside them is refused unless the plugin saw it arrive in the same chat

gitBin.description: git, for counting commits not yet on GitHub

procRoot.description: /proc, to tell whether the runner's lock is held by a live runner process

githubOwners.description: GitHub owners whose repos a project may use (default AdamHikl)

newRepoScript.description: The Mac command Jorah names for putting a local-only project on GitHub

toolboxDir.description: Jorah's toolbox, /opt/jorah-toolbox (owned by jorah-toolbox; read here for installed.json)

toolboxVar.description: The toolbox's queue, /var/lib/jorah-toolbox: proposals, approvals (written only by toolbox_install and toolbox_remove), results, smoke tests

benches.description: Bench names the runner knows (its BENCHES), default ["robotics"]
